g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: Rev C step 4 - precision supply and pack monitoring

g.desc: Title: Rev C step 4 - precision supply and pack monitoring

g.text: SUPPLY AND PACK SUPERVISION - TPS389001, OPEN-DRAIN, LOW = FAULT

g.desc: SUPPLY AND PACK SUPERVISION - TPS389001, OPEN-DRAIN, LOW = FAULT

g.text: Low below 6.61 V: firmware stops capture and syncs files. No guaranteed shutdown time.

g.desc: Low below 6.61 V: firmware stops capture and syncs files. No guaranteed shutdown time.

g.text: Asserts below 5.77 V, above LT3045 dropout, so the analogue rail is switched off while still in regulation.

g.desc: Asserts below 5.77 V, above LT3045 dropout, so the analogue rail is switched off while still in regulation.

g.text: Asserts below 4.83 V nominal (31.6k/9.88k, Step 13); 100 nF C0G gives ~107 ms release delay after AVDD is valid. Holds the ADC in reset.

g.desc: Asserts below 4.83 V nominal (31.6k/9.88k, Step 13); 100 nF C0G gives ~107 ms release delay after AVDD is valid. Holds the ADC in reset.

g.text: Asserts below 6.23 V (44.2k/10k) at the protected pack terminals; inhibits analogue power and clears the restart latch.

g.desc: Asserts below 6.23 V (44.2k/10k) at the protected pack terminals; inhibits analogue power and clears the restart latch.

g.text: Monitor PACK_POS at the protected pack terminals and SYS at the charger output. 0.1 % dividers; no filter capacitor on SENSE.

g.desc: Monitor PACK_POS at the protected pack terminals and SYS at the charger output. 0.1 % dividers; no filter capacitor on SENSE.

g.text: 4.7k pull-ups keep edges <= 118 ns/V at 30 pF for the Schmitt-input AUP gates (Step 10). Keep each output net <= 30 pF.

g.desc: 4.7k pull-ups keep edges <= 118 ns/V at 30 pF for the Schmitt-input AUP gates (Step 10). Keep each output net <= 30 pF.

g.text: Asserts below 3.15 V; ~107 ms release. Also the MCU reset line (with button and SWD reset).

g.desc: Asserts below 3.15 V; ~107 ms release. Also the MCU reset line (with button and SWD reset).
